title: #058. Pickup & Delivery Vehicle Routing (PDP)
subtitle: Route vehicles for paired pickup-delivery requests enforcing same-vehicle pairing, precedence, load capacity, and stop limits.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { routes, totalDistance }.
judge.m1: Field "routes" must be an array of routes.
judge.m3: Route {p0} must be an integer array of length at least 3 ([0, ..., 0]).
judge.m4: Route {p0} must start and end at depot 0.
judge.m6: Node index {p0} is out of valid range [1, {p1}].
judge.m7: Node {p0} is visited more than once.
judge.m8: Route {p0} load at node {p1} is {p2}, outside [0, {p3}].
judge.m9: Stop {p0} was not visited by any route.
judge.m10: Request {p0} (pickup {p1}, delivery {p2}) was split across different vehicles.
judge.m12: Reported totalDistance ({p0}) does not match computed route distance ({p1}).
judge.m13: Valid pickup-delivery routes, but totalDistance ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
